RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of bias, any more than an all-men panel would be evidence against a male candidate. Panels get composed from whoever holds senior or HR roles; with small numbers, single-sex panels happen by chance fairly often. Leading with it would make you look like you're reaching, and would undercut your stronger points.

Your stronger points are substantive: a head-of-group role weighs business development and client relationships heavily, which is exactly what the announcement cites — so her appointment has a plausible merit rationale, even if you'd have ranked the criteria differently. More years of design work doesn't automatically win.

Do chase the written explanation. Two weeks of silence is the legitimate grievance. Ask for scoring against the published criteria.
